correctness.rationale: The q-cell Markov partition for the rank-one planar map is primitive, has transition P(0,j)=1/q and deterministic countdown j→j−1, and gives pi_j=2(q-j)/(q(q+1)). Its returns to state zero are iid uniform 1,...,q; the standard renewal CLT gives variance Var(R)/E(R)^3=2(q−1)/[3(q+1)^2]. The Feynman–Kac/Perron positive eigenvalue for the visit-count tilt satisfies lambda^q=(e^t/q)sum_{j=0}^{q−1}lambda^j; the untitled pressure gives 0 and tilt log(q) gives topological entropy. Root bracketing at t=log q+s yields lambda→1+e^s and log lambda→log(1+e^s); with s=0 the same root yields log2−2^(−q−1)+O(q4^(−q)). Independent reconstruction checked the Perron-root identity at 45 (q,t) values for q=3..11 and exact stationary pi. Finite tests corroborate, while primitive Markov and root arguments establish all q≥3 and real t.
